title: Grilling session: presence, consent record, recording switch, transcript file, per-agent channel
summary: Adds the host laptop's grilling session logic in the main process: presence, consent tick, recording switch writing the session transcript file through the store, and per-agent open channels with use it / type / skip / jump; 76 new tests, all with fakes. Not yet reachable from the app: the meeting panel story wires it.
friction: CI cannot run on this account (no GitHub Actions minutes; both jobs fail in 2 s), so by the person's word both merges were gated on the full gate run locally on the merged result; main has no CI record for these merges until minutes return

deferred.what: Nothing in the app can reach the session yet: no IPC channels and not registered at startup; the agent runtime, store and transcriber it needs are created privately inside other features
deferred.why: Out of scope; the meeting panel story wires it

deferred.what: That a line break (Ctrl+J) adds a line in Claude Code's input box without sending is tested only against a fake terminal, never real Claude Code

The 15 s outlier clock starts when the previous slice is dropped while the real one-at-a-time transcriber is still busy with that outlier, so healthy slices behind a long outlier are dropped too (meeting words lost from the session record); an engine call that never answers drops every later slice
deferred.why: Needs a decision on when the clock starts (the Transcriber interface does not say) and a test over the sequential transcriber

deferred.what: Opening a channel right after startAgent types 'session: <file>' and Enter into the pty before Claude Code's prompt is up, so the Enter can answer a startup question and the agent records use-it answers as pasted text instead of citing the session
deferred.why: The runtime has no ready signal yet; the meeting panel decides when channels open
